zh-CN.title: 新增活动日志与独立分卷存储

sections.title: 活动日志
items: 设置页新增活动日志表格，记录命令运行、命令与分类管理、收藏置顶、导入导出及设置重置操作
支持按消息、对象、类型和结果筛选，详情可行内展开，并支持分页跳转和内容自适应列宽
日志可按条数、天数或大小自动清理，也可长期保留并设置 MB 或 GB 提醒阈值

sections.title: 日志存储
items: 活动日志改为保存在独立的 activity-logs 目录中，并按 10 MB 自动分卷为 JSONL 文件
旧版 logs.json 会自动迁移，打开日志位置会直接进入活动日志目录

zh-CN.notice: 更新后请完整重启 Tabby。现有命令库和插件设置会保留，旧运行日志会自动迁移。

en.title: Add activity logs with independent segmented storage

sections.title: Activity logs
items: Add an activity log table to Settings for command runs, command and category management, favorites and pins, imports and exports, and settings resets
Filter by message, object, type, and result; expand details inline; jump between pages; and size columns to their content
Automatically retain logs by count, age, or size, or keep them indefinitely with a configurable MB or GB warning threshold

sections.title: Log storage
items: Store activity logs in a dedicated activity-logs directory and automatically rotate them into 10 MB JSONL segments
Automatically migrate the legacy logs.json file and open the activity log directory directly from Settings

en.notice: Fully restart Tabby after updating. Existing command libraries and plugin settings are preserved, and legacy runtime logs are migrated automatically.
